title: E0060: SQL injection
plain_english: This rule reports SQL query calls where user-controlled input is included in the query string. An attacker may be able to change the meaning of the query by supplying crafted input.
why_matters: SQL injection can expose, modify, or delete data, bypass authentication, or lead to broader system compromise depending on database permissions and application behavior.
what_it_checks: SQL execution calls such as `mysqli_query()`, `mysqli_real_query()`, `mysqli_multi_query()`, `mysql_query()`, `pg_query()`, `pg_exec()`, `pg_send_query()`, `sqlite_query()`, and `sqlite_exec()`
Cases where user-controlled input reaches the SQL argument, based on taint analysis and dynamic-expression heuristics
